chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal, who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: The adhan is in pairs, in pairs, and the iqamah is in pairs, in pairs.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَذَانُ: The call announcing the time of salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةُ: The call immediately preceding the commencement of salat (prayer)
key_terms.سَمِعْتُ: I heard; a direct statement of transmission from the narrator
key_terms.مَثْنَى: In pairs; recited two at a time

ai.seo_question: How many times are the phrases of the adhan and iqamah recited according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the numerical pattern of the phrases in the adhan and the iqamah, indicating that their sections are recited two by two. It is a jurisprudential narration related to the form of ritual worship and the established practice of salat (prayer).
